evidence: src/index/txindex.cpp, src/index/txindex.h, and associated index tests are modified to allow txindex to operate on pruned nodes.
rationale: Resolves four long-standing issues dating back to 2017 requesting txindex support on pruned nodes (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By removing the requirement to store the full raw block history on disk, it provides a major user-facing enhancement for resource-constrained node operators.
